text_block_list.name: Lyrael
text_block_list.text: Princess Violet! What on earth is that appearance...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヴァイオレット姫──
その姿は一体……！？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: I surmise it is as though she has awakened to an enlightened compassion, vast as the ocean that embraces all. It feels as though I behold a divine descent before my very eyes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
万象を包みし海原の如く、
慈心の悟りに目覚めたかと拝察せり。
まるで神仏の天降りを目にしたかの如き心持ちに候。

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: This feeling welling up from the depths of my heart is compassion. No matter what happens, I will protect my country and its people to the very end—that is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
心の奥底から湧き上がるこの気持ちは、
慈しみ。
なにがあっても
国と民とを、
守り通してみせる──
それが。

text_block_list.name: Violet
text_block_list.text: THAT IS MY PRIDE I STAND UPON!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それこそが、
わたくしの矜持です！
